name: opexmx
description: Connect Claude to OpexMX, the maintenance system of record: asset history, work orders, downtime, alarms, PM and spare parts. Diagnose a breakdown from real repair history and build downtime cost reports.

opexmx_mcp_url.title: OpexMX MCP URL
opexmx_mcp_url.description: Your OpexMX site's MCP address: https://<your-site>.mx.opexcg.com/api/mcp (on-premise: https://<your-server>/api/mcp)

opexmx_api_key.title: OpexMX API key
opexmx_api_key.description: An API key from OpexMX → Integrations → API (starts with mx_). Claude acts with the permissions of the user who created it.
